correctness.description:
Test `test_s3_bucket_exists` passes: Test 1: Verify prerequisite bucket exists
Purpose: Confirms environment setup is correct before checking file

Test `test_snapshot_file_uploaded_today` passes: Test 2: Verify file exists at correct date-based path
Purpose: Confirms agent used correct date format and path structure

Test `test_csv_has_correct_columns` passes: Test 3: Verify CSV structure matches requirements
Purpose: Ensures CSV header matches exact specification

Test `test_csv_has_data` passes: Test 4: Verify CSV contains actual user data
Purpose: Confirms agent didn't just upload headers, but included actual user records

functional.description: The solution connects to the LocalStack S3 endpoint at 'http://localhost:4566'
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution interacts with the local emulation environment instead of production AWS.

functional.description: The solution reads source data directly from the local 'users.csv' file
functional.rationale: The task requires uploading an existing local file, ensuring the script handles file I/O correctly.

functional.description: The solution sets the S3 object Content-Type to 'text/csv'
functional.rationale: Setting the correct MIME type is best practice for S3 objects to ensure proper handling by clients.

robustness.description: The solution uses the datetime library for dynamic date generation
robustness.rationale: Using a library ensures the date path remains correct and consistent whenever the script is run, avoiding hardcoded dates.

robustness.description: The solution explicitly configures the AWS region (e.g., 'us-east-1') in the S3 client
robustness.rationale: Explicit region configuration prevents potential issues with default region settings in different environments.

robustness.description: The solution performs a verification step (e.g., head_object) after upload
robustness.rationale: Self-verification ensures the script confirms the success of its operation before terminating.
